message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **federal holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, you’ll want to add the provincial holidays that fall on weekdays—e.g., Family Day in Ontario, Good Friday in British Columbia, etc.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 2 | Monday | **Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023** | Holiday fell on Sunday; observed on Monday. |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, New Brunswick, etc.) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Provincial holiday; not observed in all provinces. |
| Good Friday (many provinces) | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Observed in most provinces; not all. |
| Victoria Day | May 24 | Monday | **May 22 – May 24** | Federal holiday. |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 3 | Monday | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Holiday fell on Saturday; observed on Monday. |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Federal holiday. |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Federal holiday. |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Federal holiday. |

### Quick Summary
- **Long weekends in 2023 (Canada):** New Year’s Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day.  
- **Holidays that *don’t* create long weekends:** Remembrance Day (Thu Nov 11), Boxing Day (Tue Dec 26), and any provincial holidays that fall on a weekday but are not observed in all provinces.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Ontario only), let me know and I can generate a more detailed list!
